pattern_library.name: Recursive Depth
pattern_library.description: Nested patterns with self-similar structures representing recursive function calls
pattern_library.code_template:
stack(
  note("{base_note}").fast({outer_speed}),
  note("{base_note}").fast({outer_speed} * 2).gain(0.7),
  note("{base_note}").fast({outer_speed} * 4).gain(0.5),
  sound("{synth}").lpf({cutoff})
).every({cycle_count}, x => x.rev())
pattern_library.example:
// Recursion: nested call stack
stack(
  note("c3 e3 g3 c4").fast(2),
  note("c3 e3 g3 c4").fast(4).gain(0.7),
  note("c3 e3 g3 c4").fast(8).gain(0.5),
  sound("bd*2,hh*3").gain(0.8)
).every(4, x => x.rev())

pattern_library.name: Parallel Threads
pattern_library.description: Multiple simultaneous voices representing concurrent thread execution
pattern_library.example:
// Concurrency: multiple threads racing
stack(
  sound("hh*8").gain(0.6),
  sound("9000_perc*4").gain(0.8).speed(1.2),
  sound("sd*2").gain(0.7),
  sound("9000_bd*4").lpf(300)
)

pattern_library.name: Transaction Cycle
pattern_library.description: Repeating motifs with variations representing database commit/rollback patterns
pattern_library.example:
// Database: transaction with commit/rollback
sound("sd")
  .struct("t ~ t ~ t ~ t ~")
  .every(8, x => x.gain(1.2))  // commit boost
  .every(16, x => x.rev().gain(0.5))  // rollback reversal
  .lpf(1000)

pattern_library.name: Discrete States
pattern_library.description: Pattern transitions representing finite state machine state changes

parameters.pattern: c3 d3 e3 f3 g3 a3 b3 c4

pattern_library.example:
// State machine: discrete state transitions
note("c3 d3 e3 f3 g3 a3 b3 c4")
  .sound("gm_piano")
  .chunk(4, (x, n) => n % 2 === 0 ? x.fast(2) : x.slow(1.5))
  .gain(0.7)

pattern_library.name: Throttled Requests
pattern_library.description: Pattern with enforced gaps representing API rate limiting
pattern_library.example:
// API rate limiting: throttled requests
sound("clap")
  .euclid(5, 16)
  .every(8, x => x.slow(2).gain(0.5))
  .gain(0.8)

pattern_library.name: Cleanup Cycle
pattern_library.description: Pattern with periodic cleanup sweeps representing GC pauses

parameters.main_pattern: c3 d3 e3 f3 g3 a3 b3 c4

pattern_library.name: Distributed Services
pattern_library.description: Multiple independent patterns representing microservice communication
pattern_library.example:
// Microservices: distributed communication
stack(
  note("c3 ~ e3 ~ g3 ~ c4 ~").sound("square").lpf(800),
  note("~ e3 ~ g3 ~ b3 ~ e4").sound("sawtooth").late(0.125).lpf(1000),
  note("~ ~ g3 ~ ~ c4 ~ ~").sound("gm_piano").late(0.25).lpf(1200),
  sound("bd").gain(0.6)
)

pattern_library.name: Round Robin
pattern_library.description: Rotating pattern distribution representing load balancer behavior
pattern_library.example:
// Load balancer: round robin distribution
sound("9000_perc")
  .iter(4)
  .gain("0.7 0.8 0.75 0.85")
  .speed("1.0 1.1 0.9 1.05")

usage_guidelines.selection_strategy: Match technical concept to pattern template based on suitable_for_concepts field
usage_guidelines.customization: Adjust parameters based on BPM, mood, and desired intensity
usage_guidelines.combination: Stack multiple templates for complex concepts (e.g., async + concurrency)
usage_guidelines.synth_selection: Choose synths based on technical mood: harsh for low-level, ambient for high-level
usage_guidelines.evidence_tracking: Link generated patterns back to extracted knowledge evidence IDs
